label: Regulatory Examination Preparation
description: Prepares institutions for regulatory examinations (FI, BaFin, FCA, AMLA). Conducts pre-exam gap assessment, document readiness review, and staff preparation briefings.

claudeKnowledge.description: Supervisory examination methodologies, SREP, regulatory inspection priorities, enforcement trends

guidedInputs.label: Regulatory Authority
guidedInputs.description: Which regulatory authority is conducting the examination?

guidedInputs.label: Examination Type
guidedInputs.description: What type of regulatory examination is this?

guidedInputs.label: Examination Date / Deadline
guidedInputs.description: When is the examination scheduled or when is the response deadline?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. On-site visit: 15–19 March 2025. Document submission deadline: 28 February 2025

guidedInputs.label: Known Examination Focus Areas
guidedInputs.description: Any known focus areas from the regulator's advance letter or prior supervisory correspondence.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Regulator's advance letter indicates focus on: (1) beneficial ownership verification, (2) PEP identification and EDD quality, (3) SAR filing rates and quality, (4) training programme effectiveness...

guidedInputs.label: Prior Examination Findings
guidedInputs.description: Summary of findings from previous examinations, regulatory letters, or enforcement actions.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. 2022 FI examination: findings on KYC periodic review backlogs (action plan submitted Dec 2022, reported as addressed Feb 2023). Dear CEO letter Jan 2024 on PEP controls industry-wide...

guidedInputs.label: Institution Overview
guidedInputs.description: Brief description of the institution: size, products, customer base, and AML programme structure.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Mid-size Swedish bank, €8bn balance sheet, 120,000 retail customers, 4,500 SME customers, 200 corporate. MLRO in Stockholm with team of 12 FCP staff. Uses Actimize for TM, Fenergo for KYC...
